weakness since 1 month ,fever since 1 week,altered sensorium since 3 days.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHOPI:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 month he has been complaining of generalised weakness. Since 15 days he has been feeling cold(even though it is summer) and has been switching off all the fans in the house.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe has been suffering with constipation since 10 days. Has not passed stools at all(confirmed by the attender) He did not take any medication for it\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe also complained of abdominal distension\/bloating due to not passing stools.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 1 week he has fever insidious in onset gradually progressive, high grade. Associated with body pains.Not Associated with chills and rigor. Not relieved with medication.Not associated with nausea, vomiting, burning micturition, headache.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESince 3 days -he fell in the washroom two times(on 22\/5\/1023)and was not able to get up. When his family members found him, he had slurring of speech and altered sensorium.They took him to the Nalgonda government hospital.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThere they gave him an enema and his constipation and bloating was relieved immediately.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey also treated him symptomatically. But he was still in altered sensorium and did not cover\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey then shifted him to a private hospital as they had contacts there. There they did MRI and found that infarct in the cortical and subcortical regions of occiput.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ebut due to too expensive in that hospital so after tracheostomy in view of low GCS (24\/05\/23 morning) they came to our hospital. On the way in the ambulance, he was able to recognise his family. They brought him to the casualty .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 30\/5\/2023:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe developed scrotal swelling at afternoon.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESurgery referral taken:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn P\/A examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECrepts + ,over abdomen wall b\/l lateral aspects extending upto upper 1\/3 rd aspects rt thigh and 2\/3 rd of lt thigh.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EL\/E : scrotal edema + , no local raise of temp. Tenderness can't be elicited.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EScrotal skin rugocities absent.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECreptations + in scrotum on palpation.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo fluctuation,get above the swelling+.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiagnosis- surgical emphysema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAdvised - no surgical intervention needed. Emphysema will resolve spontaneously.if persists then plan for skin Nick's.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe developed SOB, sudden in onset,grade 4 MMR, orthopnea present , No PND.\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPulmonology refferal was taken I\/v\/o sob and fall in saturations,tachycardia and tachypnea.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPt. Is connected to the mechnical ventilation i\/v\/o fall in saturation,tachypnea and tachycardia.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThey advised chest x ray -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Echest x ray PA view showed pneumothorax.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;On percussion- hyperresonant .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENeedle thoracocentesis was immediately started than ICD was placed at 5 th ICS.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn 10\/6\/2023:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Erepositioning of ICD was done.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn15\/6\/2023:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBlood transfusion was done.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EO 16\/6\/2023:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EC\/o suprapubic bulge from Night onwards.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUrology referral was taken:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOn P\/A soft, tenderness+ in all quadrants of abdomen. Suprapubic tenderness +.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EFoley's Insitu. Scrotum normal.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAdvised USG abdomen\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EInPast history\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn 2019 end of the year-\u0026nbsp; He has felt \"weak\" .\u0026nbsp; One fine day he fell down(due to low energy) while cycling and was immediately rushed to the hospital. They told him his cervical nerves got compressed and said he needed surgery. But due to family issues, he didn't get surgery then, and got it done after 2 months( cervical spondylosis surgery). He recovered after 6 months and started walking with support of a stick since then. The doctors then discovered he had problems in the lumbar region as well (4 years back) and needed surgery too, but didn't give consent for that surgery as they told him he would never be able to walk.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/o htn since 4 years using medication irregularly\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EN\/k\/c\/ DM, asthma, epilepsy, thyroid, CAD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPersonal history:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiet-mixed\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppetite - normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESleep - adequate\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBowel and bladder - bowel (constipation),bladder normal.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAddiction - drinks toddy occasionally\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGeneral Examination:\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is C\/C\/C\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EModerately build and nourished.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo pallor,icterus,cynosis,clubbing, lymphadenopathy,pedal edema.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EVitals\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemp 101F\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EBp -130\/90 mmhg\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPr -102 bpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERr - 20 cpm\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESpo2 100% on 4 liters of RA\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ESystemic examination:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EGCS- E4 V (NT) M6\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPower -\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Rt. Type 2 respiratory failure septic shock with grade 2 bed sore"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"navya lakkakula"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/14546558071900964134"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}],"media$thumbnail":{"xmlns$media":"http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/","url":"https:\/\/blogger.googleusercontent.com\/img\/b\/R29vZ2xl\/AVvXsEhyvaeRvcDLwhyphenhyphen8opCh72ThWuNuOZJlNjqp4KyVjYUnqu6oMIV5pHi4J4ja2LNl7-5XGrEE6vPKXPfdPV6-9uHDqrIyCTCgggq34wI4WKR4KVxMH_-lodU5o2MUK5zu7HgHZqd2MkKqB3qr\/s72-c\/1685990749341321-0.png","height":"72","width":"72"}},{"id":{"$t":"tag:blogger.com,1999:blog-8690545989416577695.post-2817370464825384525"},"published":{"$t":"2023-04-07T09:18:00.001-07:00"},"updated":{"$t":"2023-04-08T23:25:50.754-07:00"},"title":{"type":"text","$t":"thesis"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cdiv\u003ETitle : Clinical predictors and outcomes in patients with sepsis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAim : To understand\u0026nbsp; the factors influencing outcomes in patients with sepsis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EProblem statement-Sepsis is a life-threatening condition caused by a dysregulated immune response to an infection. Despite advances in medical care, sepsis remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality worldwide. Early recognition and prompt treatment of sepsis are critical for improving outcomes\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETherefore, the problem statement for exploring the diagnostic and therapeutic factors influencing outcomes in patients with sepsis is to identify the key clinical, laboratory, and imaging features that contribute to the early detection and accurate diagnosis of sepis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAdditionally, there is a need to better understand the patient-related factors, such as age, comorbidities on the course and outcomes of sepsis. By addressing these\u0026nbsp; healthcare providers can develop evidence based approaches to the prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of sepsis, ultimately reducing mortality rates and improving the quality of care for patients with sepsis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EObjectives :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E1. To study the clinical predictors of sepsis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E2. To asses the risk of morbidity and mortality using sepsis scores ( sofa, qsofa, )\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E3. To study the patient centered outcomes in patients with sepsis.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMethodology :\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter taking a written consent from the patients\/relatives, a detailed history is taken and a thorough physical\u0026nbsp; and systemic examinations are performed according to self-designed case report forms. The case report forms, document the patient’s name, age, sex, comorbidities, risk factors associated with sepsis, and family history etc.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe findings of the clinical exam are also recorded in this case report form along with baseline sepsis scores at admission and in-hospital with localisation of sepsis at organ level, which includes the neurological,\u0026nbsp; cardiovascular, respiratory and gastrointestinal\u0026nbsp; system. Blood cultures and with selected panel of investigations are done to narrow down differentials and to get diagnosis.\u003C\/div\u003E"},"link":[{"rel":"edit","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8690545989416577695\/posts\/default\/2817370464825384525"},{"rel":"self","type":"application/atom+xml","href":"https:\/\/www.blogger.com\/feeds\/8690545989416577695\/posts\/default\/2817370464825384525"},{"rel":"alternate","type":"text/html","href":"https:\/\/navya96.blogspot.com\/2023\/04\/thesis.html","title":"thesis"}],"author":[{"name":{"$t":"navya lakkakula"},"uri":{"$t":"http:\/\/www.blogger.com\/profile\/14546558071900964134"},"email":{"$t":"noreply@blogger.com"},"gd$image":{"rel":"http://schemas.google.com/g/2005#thumbnail","width":"16","height":"16","src":"https:\/\/img1.blogblog.com\/img\/b16-rounded.gif"}}]}]}}
